The sweetness of control.
In a Volvo, there’s no doubt who’s in command. Everything – from the ergonomic
seat design to the advanced driver-control interface – has been created with
one single purpose: to give you, as driver, the best imaginable support for an
inspiring and relaxed drive. To achieve this, control is essential. That’s why
we designed the new driver-control interface, Volvo Sensus, as an intuitive
command center. Complete control is at your fingertips. With an integrated
thumb scroll on the steering wheel, you have full control of the car and
all in-car entertainment, navigation*, park assist camera* and Bluetooth®
communication systems – with both hands on the steering wheel. All information
